title: Recovered exact-candidate native case ledger
interpretation: Nine selected fresh executions were previously initiated/read by this auditor; this checkpoint rereads their existing immutable logs.
Observed native statuses are writer test outputs, not automatically independent business verdicts.
Only complete single-line JSON objects are parsed; fixture/seed diagnostics are excluded from case counts.
Approved-oracle overlays, calendar-policy analysis and historical result groups are separate; do not combine their counts as new unique tests.
Each log SHA256 hashes the decoded UTF-8 text as returned by GitHub (including initial BOM and trailing LF). Earlier local files appended one further LF; their hashes are recorded separately.
Actual start/attempt mapping is retained from prior verified run metadata. This continuation did not obtain fresh job metadata: direct /actions/jobs/{id} was unsupported by github_fetch.
Raw logs remain retrievable by job ID; this ledger retains exact structured per-case output and selected cleanup/identity results without publishing setup logs.
Do not interpret missing detail in a case's PASS-only record as proof of its business oracle.
